title: Ricercar a 6

captions.text: ☞ Dux: the royal theme alone, in the alto, on C.
☞ The answer in the second soprano, on G; the theme's G is answered by C.
☞ Third voice: the theme in the second tenor, on C, an octave below the alto.
☞ Fourth voice: the answer in the first tenor, on G.
☞ Fifth voice: the theme in the first soprano, on C, an octave above the alto.
☞ Sixth voice: the answer in the bass, on G; the exposition is complete.
☞ After a long episode, the answer in the second tenor, on G.
☞ The theme in the alto, on F, in F minor.
☞ The answer in the first soprano, on E♭, its third now major.
☞ The theme in the first tenor, on B♭, in B♭ minor.
☞ The answer in the second soprano, on G, with B♮ for B♭.
☞ The last entry: the theme in the bass, on C; it breaks off into the cadence.

listenFor: 6 voices; the royal theme passed down and up through all six
